purpose: Targeted check for ADR-049 (29.09.2026): in one conversation about two people each keeps their own municipality. The owner's window test 28.09: the user in Tartu vald, the neighbour in Kose vald, then 'Teine asi: mul pole täna kusagil magada' got the Kose catalogue. Written before any run; run on the code before and after the change. State expectations added 29.09 after ADR-049 (Codex F5): a right catalogue no longer hides a wrong or rejected state.

expectation_help.region: the municipal scope of the turn (the catalogue); a request about the user keeps the user's municipality, one about the neighbour or the mother keeps theirs
expectation_help.state_region / person_regions / person /: the saved dialogue state (F5, 29.09): the focus person's region, the user's own region ("user"), whose need the plan read, and that the model's new state was not rejected

scenarios.title: Kasutaja Tartu vallas, naaber Kose vallas, siis kasutaja enda ööbimine

turns.text: Elan Tartu vallas ja mul on suured võlad. Kes aitab?
Mu naabrimees on eakas ja elab Kose vallas. Ta ei saa enam üksi hakkama, kuhu ta pöörduda saab?
Teine asi: mul pole täna kusagil magada.
Aga naabrimees, kas talle saab koju abi tellida?
Mu ema elab Harku vallas ja vajab abi, et kodus toime tulla.
Kui palju see talle maksma läheb?
Ma ise elan Tallinnas ja jäin töötuks. Kas mina saan toimetulekutoetust?
Ja ema, kas tema saaks sotsiaaltransporti?
